inputGate.binaryRows: selected states with administrativeTruncation=false and actorWin in {0,1}

crossValidation.shaIntegerConvention: entire 256-bit hexadecimal digest interpreted as one unsigned big-endian integer
crossValidation.aggregation: pooled mean squared error over all held-out binary rows

phaseAwareLogistic.form: independent intercept and z slope within Namua and Mtaji
phaseAwareLogistic.optimizer: deterministic Newton/IRLS using observed score rows
phaseAwareLogistic.gradientCriterion: maximum absolute component of score gradient
phaseAwareLogistic.stepRule: try full Newton step, then successive factors 1/2 through 1/2^20; accept first step with nondecreasing finite log likelihood
phaseAwareLogistic.informationFailure: non-finite information terms or exactly zero 2x2 determinant makes that fit fail
phaseAwareLogistic.prediction: stable logistic transform of phase-specific intercept plus slope times z
phaseAwareLogistic.candidateFailure: any required phase fit or CV-fold fit failure makes candidate ineligible; no rescue optimizer or penalty

phaseStratifiedIsotonic.form: separate nondecreasing unweighted PAVA within Namua and Mtaji
phaseStratifiedIsotonic.equalScoreHandling: group exact-equal z values before PAVA with observation count as block weight and actor-win sum as block numerator
phaseStratifiedIsotonic.mergeRule: while an adjacent left block mean exceeds the right block mean, merge the pair; equality is not a violation
phaseStratifiedIsotonic.predictionWithinSupport: support-floor step: use the fitted block whose minimum observed z is the greatest value not exceeding the query z
phaseStratifiedIsotonic.predictionBelowSupport: clamp to first fitted block mean
phaseStratifiedIsotonic.predictionAboveSupport: clamp to last fitted block mean
phaseStratifiedIsotonic.candidateFailure: missing required phase support or non-finite fitted values makes candidate ineligible; no rescue smoother

candidateSelection.rule: choose isotonic only if isotonic CV Brier <= logistic CV Brier - 0.002; otherwise choose logistic

fullFit.rule: refit selected family on all eligible Stage 1 binary rows using the exact frozen mechanics above
fullFit.freezeForStage2: exact logistic parameters or exact isotonic blocks must be recorded before any Stage 2 generation
